name: imageo
description: SPFx 1.23 Application Customizer that turns SharePoint page context into brand-styled images with Microsoft Foundry MAI-Image-2.5-Flash.
author: Nello D'Andrea

scripts.deploy: node -e "if(process.env.npm_config_dry_run==='true'){console.error('Use \"npm run deploy:dry-run\" — npm consumes --dry-run before npx sees it.');process.exit(2)}" && npx -y github:ferrarirosso/spfx-foundry-deploy deploy --config ./spfx/deploy.config.json
